game.title: Forza Horizon 4
game.blurb: Open-world racing game set in a shared world loosely based on Britain, with weekly changing seasons, from Playground Games, released 2018-10-02. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Festival and the Seasons
chapters.summary: Arriving at the festival, qualifying through the four seasons, Seasonal Championships and Festival Playlist series.

chapters.title: Racing Series and Showcases
chapters.summary: Road, dirt, cross country and drag series, Street Scene, Showcases, The Trial and the long-distance races.

chapters.title: Horizon Stories
chapters.summary: The story chapters: British Racing Green, Isha's Taxis, Skill Streak, the Top Gear special, The Car Files and more.

chapters.title: Exploring Britain
chapters.summary: Bonus Boards, Barn Finds, Beauty Spots, every road, PR stunts, houses and the castle.

chapters.title: Cars, Skills and Challenges
chapters.summary: Buying cars, Car Mastery, Wheelspins, levels, skill chains, Horizon Promo photos, Challenge Cards and car-specific feats.

chapters.title: Online Play
chapters.summary: #FORZATHON events, co-op and PvP races, Team and Free-for-All Adventures, Rivals, Super7 and player Blueprints.

chapters.title: The Eliminator
chapters.summary: The battle-royale style Eliminator mode, its Head-to-Heads and Car Drops.

chapters.title: Fortune Island (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Island Conqueror, Treasure Chests, the island's roads and PR stunts, and the Leviathan and Kraken.

chapters.title: LEGO Speed Champions (expansion)
chapters.summary: LEGO Valley: the Master Builder's House, Speed Champions events, Brick Challenges and collectables.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1293830)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Forza_Horizon_4
Fandom (forza.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://forza.fandom.com/wiki/Forza_Horizon_4
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs); only a Table of Contents subpage exists (about 370 characters). No page on forzamotorsport.fandom.com (the API answered HTTP 404); forza.fandom.com answers the API under "Forza Horizon 4", with about 28 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Forza Horizon 4 is not in the Steam store app list (IStoreService GetAppList), and the Steam store API marks app 1293830 as unlisted with no purchase option; the app id came from RAWG's Steam store link. Its achievement schema still answers; the schema calls the app "Sunrise" (an internal codename). None of the 178 Steam achievements are hidden. Five achievements listed in the Fortune Island block whose descriptions do not name the island ("Not Just Straight-line Speed", a Trailblazer Gate star, and four car-specific stunts at named places: "Wait…how did you do that?", "Full of Zest", "The OG", "Exodus of Exocet") were put in Fortune Island by schema position next to the Kraken and Leviathan ones, and "Learning to Fly" (Airport Leap Danger Sign) and "Out-of-Towners" (unexpected guests at your House) in LEGO Speed Champions by their position in the LEGO block; these need checking. Challenge Card and Blueprint Builder achievements sit in Cars, Skills and Challenges.
